title: Bloom update feed, form 1
description: The content a release signs for its channel. It is published inside a DSSE envelope with the payload type application/vnd.bloom.update-feed+json; a reader checks the envelope's Ed25519 signature before it reads this content. A reader ignores members and file kinds it does not know.

channel.description: The release channel: the first pre-release word of the version (alpha, beta), or stable.

version.description: The newest version of the channel, as Semantic Versioning 2.0.0.

notes.description: The release notes: the version's section of CHANGELOG.md, as Markdown.

platforms.description: By platform key: linux-x86_64, macos-arm64, windows-x86_64.

appcast.description: The HTTPS address of the list the platform's own updater reads (macOS, Windows).

kind.description: What the file is: tar, appimage, zsync (Linux); zip, dmg, pkg (macOS); installer, zip (Windows).

signature.description: The Ed25519 signature of the file's bytes, as Base64.
